retrieval_policy.current_job: Snapshot-only preparation; no external retrieval was attempted.
later_jobs_may: Retrieve publicly accessible resources when the job explicitly authorizes network retrieval and applicable terms permit it.
Record canonical URL, retrieval timestamp, content hash or immutable revision, license or access classification, and validator label for every acquired artifact.
Classify concrete assignment or lesson boundaries before adding them to the unit graph.
later_jobs_must_not: Bypass authentication, paywalls, sharing controls, robots restrictions, or other access controls.
Treat a successful link discovery as proof that content was retrieved, licensed, complete, or suitable for learner distribution.
Copy secrets, hidden graders, sealed references, or another learner's files into learner-visible materials.
Infer lecture recordings or a full official sequence when the source does not provide them.
retrieval_policy.on_unavailable_or_restricted: Record the material as blocked with the observed reason and continue only with independently authorized, provenance-labeled alternatives.
retrieval_policy.unit_promotion_rule: Only a later, verified classification job may promote a normalized resource record into an official course-unit node.
